claims.sentence: Local normative acts are adopted by the University’s governing bodies within their respective competencies established by legislation and the University Charter
These acts include orders, directives, protocol decisions, regulations, rules, procedures, and instructions
Local normative acts must not contradict the legislation of the Russian Federation
When a local normative act affects the rights of students, the governing bodies must follow a specific consultation procedure before adoption

1.  **Submission of Draft:** Before making a decision to adopt the act, the governing bodies send the draft of the local normative act to the Student Council and the Parents Council for minor students (if one exists)
2.  **Student Council:** The Student Council is created upon the initiative of University students and serves as a form of their public self-government
It may represent the interests of all or part of the students
3.  **Parents Council:** The Parents Council for minor students is created upon the initiative of parents (legal representatives) and serves as a form of their public self-government
It may represent the interests of all or part of the parents (legal representatives) of students
The Student Council and the Parents Council for minor students have a deadline of five working days from the date of receiving the draft act to submit their feedback
This feedback must be a reasoned opinion submitted in writing to the corresponding collegial body or the Director
The adoption of the act depends on the response from the councils

Agreement or No Response:** If the Student Council or the Parents Council for minor students expresses agreement with the draft, or if the reasoned opinion is not received within the specified deadline, the corresponding governing body of the University adopts the local normative act
Disagree with the opinion and adopt the local normative act in its original version

Norms of local normative acts that worsen the position of students or employees compared to the position established by education legislation, labor legislation, or that are adopted in violation of the established procedure, are not applied and are subject to cancellation by the Director
